title: Playing for proms and becoming leader after Carl Thompson
summary: The band played proms at Alabama University and elsewhere, and after Carl Thompson finished Hawkins became leader within two months.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Okay. Well, what happened from the time that you joined that band until the time that you became the leader?

Well, all we was doing at that time was in school, you know, taking in the schooling, and we was going in and out travelling with the bands with the Revellers and also the Collegians. And, it was a regular thing. Like I was saying, to keep the school open, we had to go out and do certain dances, certain affairs. We'd go to certain schools to play proms and things. Alabama University wasn't but so far from us (inaudible), which was in Tuscaloosa, we used to go, they used to send for us all the time. We'd go down to Alabama University and play there a lot, for different proms and everything. And the students, we all liked each other. We were very close, those two schools. And things like that we went along.
And, how long did you play with the band before you became the leader?
I was, oh, I was in there just maybe, what, two months or something like that. That's about all. I got in because
at the time, I can't think of his name, a trumpet player who was in the band. His name, he was the leader. Then, he finished, and then they made me the leader. Carl Thompson. That's the name. Right.
